say.variants.house_alarm_open: Shit, an alarm! {addressee.name}, every deadhead in blocks is gonna hear that!
Burglar alarm just tripped! {addressee.name}, get ready for company!
Damn it, listen to that siren! Stay sharp, {addressee.name}, they'll swarm that building!
say.variants.house_alarm_reply: I hear it, {addressee.name}. Weapons up and keep moving away from that noise.
Great, just what we needed, {addressee.name}. Keep eyes on every doorway.
Copy that, {addressee.name}. Let's clear out before the whole street pours in.
say.variants.power_shutoff_open: Did everything just go dark? Looks like the power grid finally died today, {addressee.name}.
The lights aren't coming back on. The grid gave out today, {addressee.name}.
Power's finally gone for good today, {addressee.name}. Freezers and generators matter even more now.
say.variants.power_shutoff_reply: Yeah, {addressee.name}, no more free electricity. Watch the spoilage and stock fuel.
I felt the hum stop too, {addressee.name}. Flashlights and generators from here on out.
Rough milestone, {addressee.name}, but we knew it was coming. Let's adapt.
say.variants.water_shutoff_open: Pipes just ran dry today, {addressee.name}. Water system finally quit on us.
Tap water's dead as of today, {addressee.name}. Better grab every bottle and barrel we see.
Looks like the water main finally shut off today, {addressee.name}. No more easy sinks.
say.variants.water_shutoff_reply: Got it, {addressee.name}. Rain collectors and pots are top priority now.
Damn, {addressee.name}, rationing just got real. Save every drop we find.
True enough, {addressee.name}. Let's check bathtubs and rainwater before it dries up.
